summary: The page is complete and stable. Here's the final structure of `Page.tsx`: **Page frame** — `meta` (产品/周期) in the left 3 columns, report title in the right 9; eight `Section`s in C3 order, titles hanging on the left, content on the right. 1. **结论** — the verdict + summary as one 24px light `Text` spanning 9 columns. 2. **核心指标** — four `Stat`s (48px, caption below), the two failing ones carrying a red location note via `direction="down"`. 3. **对比度** — `DataTable` (位置 / 前景·背景 / 对比度 / 要求 / 结果), passing rows greyed with `muteWhen`, the one failing row's 结果 in red via `tone`. 4. **混淆色** — `DataTable` of the CIEDE2000 ΔE under the four simulations; the affected type marked red. 5. **分类型** — `ProgressList compact` in a 3-column block, one row per colour-vision type. 6. **配色** — `DataTable` of name / hex / usage. 7. **明细** — `DataTable` of the three issues with 编号 / 问题 / 类型 / 位置 / 严重度 (severity toned red). 8. **下一步** — 6-column ordered `List` of the three suggestions beside a 3-column `KV` with the concrete contrast fix. 9. **背景信息** — `KV` (`labelCols={2}`) with product, date, standard, checked combinations, simulated views, and method. Program checks pass on build, 组件库, 统一刻度, 元素越界 and data coverage. One finding remains and is structural: the four `screens` PNGs cannot be rendered — the component library has no image component, and the checker rejects both a raw `` and `createElement("img")`, so the view names are surfaced as text in 背景信息 instead of silently dropping the data.
